integrity: Finite, exact standard-library calculation; integral Morse differential and all conjugacy-class traces are recomputed from explicit definitions.
scientific_limitations: The result determines one finite natural complex only, without a uniform family theorem.
The integral degree-six orientation character is determined but an integral degree-five module isomorphism is not asserted.
Independent scientific review has not been performed, and unindexed equivalent equivariant work is possible.
title: Complete \(S_4\times S_3\)-homology characters of the Nauru independence complex
